title: Soliton Collision
subtitle: Korteweg-de Vries Non-Linear Wave Dynamics
description: Nonlinear self-reinforcing solitary wave packets governed by the KdV equation, colliding and emerging unchanged in shape.
mathNotation: \frac{\partial u}{\partial t} + 6u \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial^3 u}{\partial x^3} = 0, \quad u(x,t) = 2k^2 \operatorname{sech}^2(k(x - 4k^2 t))
formulaCompact: u(x, t) = 2k² * sech²(k(x - 4k² t)),  total_u = u1(x, t) + u2(x, -t)
